usedFor: Jotform collects form answers, and Chatbase stores each respondent as a contact when “New Submission” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Create Contact” in Chatbase
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form becomes a Chatbase contact without anyone retyping the answers.

watchOut: “New Submission” can return a single-line no-data message when nothing is found, so test with a real submission.
